title: Model how land subsidence affects flooding - building flood damage in 2050
output_type: vector/table (flooded buildings with mean depth and damage) + map
required_outputs: any result file (instruction names none); reference writes Buildings_Flooded_2050.geojson, Buildings_Flooded_2050.csv, flood_damage_2050.png
method: Flooded = Elevation_2050 (cm, RD New 5 m) <= -200; depth = Int(-(elev+200)) cm; polygonise depth (gridcode); buildings intersecting flood polygons (3928/9068); per-building area-weighted mean gridcode over the flooded part; DamageCosts = (0.298*ln(0.01*MEAN_gridcode)+1.4502)*271*Shape_Area if MEAN_gridcode > 1 else 0; total = 4.11e8.
benchmark_defects: The published reference script is an ArcGIS ModelBuilder export that uses arcpy with the Spatial and Image Analyst extensions.
The benchmark's data folder is named 'datasets'; the inputs are provided as dataset/.
The raster CRS is stored as LOCAL_CS 'Amersfoort / RD New' (no EPSG code) while buildings are EPSG:28992; coordinates coincide, but to_crs on the raster CRS can fail.
No output file and no currency/units for the damage are specified; the dataset description mislabels the 2050 elevation as 'predicted flood elevation'.
Summarize Within's mean for polygon summaries (area-weighted vs simple) is unspecified; area-weighted used, zonal means accepted.
checks: required: at least one result file in pred_results

required: a building-level table (captured, function locals, or CSV/vector file; aligned by id column, geometry or full 0..n-1 index) has a damage column whose >0 set has Jaccard >= 0.80 with gold and Spearman >= 0.90
required: per-building damage values: median pred/gold ratio on buildings damaged in both within 0.95-1.05 (log10 1.68, max depth 1.12 fail)
required: total damage within 10 % of gold 4.11e8 (scalar, column sum, or a number in a .txt/.json/.md file)
optional: per-building mean depth Spearman >= 0.9 with gold
